mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) inhibits platelet function and increases bleeding risk, while dutasteride may increase bleeding tendency through 5-alpha reductase inhibition effects on hemostasis; additionally, NSAIDs may increase dutasteride levels through CYP3A4 competition.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding and bruising; consider alternative analgesics; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring during concurrent use.
